sentences.text: Antusuchus possessed a small skull measuring approximately 11.5 cm in length.
Its diet likely included meat, as evidenced by blade-like and serrated teeth designed for cutting.

Fossils were unearthed at the La Buitrera locality in the Rio Negro Province of northern Patagonia, Argentina. This site represents a wind-influenced dryland fluvian environment where two individuals were found living close together.
Scientific classification places Antusuchus within the family Peirosauridae. Phylogenetic analyses further suggest it was the most basal member of this group.
These ancient creatures lived during the Albian stage.
Researchers debate whether Antusuchus represents a distinct basal lineage or displays intermediate features between peirosaurids and other notosuchians.
